study: Fig.3 R2.4: execution-order recovery and long-horizon composition (frozen cVAE + frozen coupled X/Y; no training, no architecture change)
written_before: any R2.4 model-side plan, physical query or analysis output
evidence_status: ALL cohorts are exposed development roots. Nothing in R2.4 is independent confirmation.
local_chunk_energy: c(S, C) = -log max(1e-8, pX(C | rebase(root, canonical prefix set S), q_ref, ORIGINAL task)); full scene, every object kept; ordered chunks of 1-3 actions; LAM = -log 0.92 per intermediate home return (R2.2 connector rate); the scored partition is the executed partition; no partial original-task Y gate.

R2.4A_3d_ordering_only.input: per root ONE private verified unordered assignment = the generator witness's (object, destination) set; the witness ORDER is never passed to the planner

arms.A-DP: exact subset-DP joint order + partition (LAM) -- PRIMARY, physically verified
arms.A-PRE: DP restricted to linear extensions of model-discovered pairwise prerequisites: d(a->b) = pY_temp(b | S0+a) - pY_temp(b | S0) on the retargeted view, edge iff d > 0.05 and d(a->b) > d(b->a), cycles broken at the weakest edge (model-only unless budget remains)

archived_controls_reused.direct_long_sequence: K45 oracle direct p11 top-1 order, continuous (5/20)
archived_controls_reused.existing_chunk_ranking: K45 oracle chunk-H top-1 order + two-group split, chunked (4/20)
archived_controls_reused.random_order: K45 seeded uniform random order, continuous (4/20)
archived_controls_reused.privileged_witness: witness order with forced q_ref split [2, m] (19/20) and the generator's continuous witness (20/20 by construction)

metrics: verified X=1,Y=1 of the committed order+partition
normalized Kendall distance to the witness order
rank and E-gap of the witness order (with its best partition) among all m! orders
first failing chunk index, prefix length h, phase (relocation / boundary)
A-PRE edge agreement with the witness order

local_X_discrimination.labels: exact-compatible chunk labels extracted from archived chunked / continuous teacher traces (K45 primary+oracle, R1, R2.1-2.2, R2.3) plus R2.4 jobs: executed chunk -> 1; chunk with the failing relocation or failing closing connector -> 0; continuous runs > 3 failing at relocation i <= 2 -> prefixes of length i+1..3 are 0; UNKNOWN outcomes give no negative; conflicting duplicates dropped
local_X_discrimination.statistic: AUROC of frozen pX by prefix length h (0 vs >= 1), family = root, cluster bootstrap 1000
local_X_discrimination.new_matched_labels: collected only if fewer than 10 mixed roots with h >= 1 remain after reuse and R2.4 jobs

R2.4B_deployment_arms.discovery: one R-FIG3 recursion per root (admit beats_empty), bounded exhaustive local groups up to 50,000 ordered groups per expansion (staged beam only above; counted as remaining truncation)

arms.R-FIG3-X: action sets of the recursion pool, each re-ordered by the joint order/partition DP (free permutations)
arms.R-FIG3-XP: same, DP restricted to the candidate's own PREREQ + LOCAL edges
arms.R-FIG3-XC: composed order kept, best partition only
arms.GA-INIT: global assignment search over the initial D4 at S0 + DP
arms.GA-UNION: global assignment search over the union of refreshed proposals from the discovery run + DP

R2.4B_deployment_arms.assignment_search: per size k: exhaustive over legal k-sets when <= 150,000, else all one-action extensions of the top 256 size-(k-1) sets by Y_global (declared truncation); shortlist top 4 sets per size by Y_global
R2.4B_deployment_arms.set_score: m <= 3: also single-chunk exact p11 at S0 over permitted orders; multi-chunk E = DP + -log Y_global(set). Y_rebased logged, never used to choose.
R2.4B_deployment_arms.selection: production NOOP gate at S0 (0.5), argmin E, ties by length, chunks, displacement, signature
R2.4B_deployment_arms.archived_comparators: R2.3 B0, R-FIG3, F-FLAT plans and labels (identical roots)
metrics: proposal coverage of known useful actions (witness / verified repairs) kept DISTINCT from executable-plan discovery: in pool, in enumerated sets, in shortlist, selected

Y_representation: identical labelled endpoints: AUROC of Y_global (original-root edit) vs Y_rebased (fresh-root no-op), split m <= 3 / m >= 4; X is always the rebased local query (never replaced by an original-scene X)

3d.job: X_CHUNKED(order, bounds = cumulative partition) + endpoint Y_TARGET(t0, goal) + replay of successes

physical.reuse: exact archived (root, ordered sequence, bounds) labels always reused (2D continuous single chunk: pool x_query + Y); dedup across arms; within a tier, roster order by sha256('R2_4|' + root); trimmed by priority, never by outcome; manifests sealed (sha256) before dispatch; no retries; censored = UNKNOWN

decision_rules.local_X: h >= 1: AUROC >= 0.75 with cluster-CI lower >= 0.60 and >= 10 mixed roots -> DISCRIMINATES; AUROC < 0.60 or CI upper < 0.70 -> FAILS; else INCONCLUSIVE (separately per domain)
decision_rules.3d_supervision: INFERENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_ORDERING iff ORDER_RECOVERED and local X DISCRIMINATES; INTERMEDIATE_X_SUPERVISION_NECESSARY iff A-DP NOT_RECOVERED or PARTIAL and (local X FAILS or >= 50% of A-DP failures occur in a chunk the model scored pX >= 0.5 at h >= 1); else UNRESOLVED
decision_rules.end_to_end: descriptive only (exposed roots, n = 20): verified counts, decided-pair discordances vs R2.3 B0 / R-FIG3 / F-FLAT; any contrast with < 10 discordant roots is NOT ESTABLISHED
decision_rules.2d: R2.4C correction reported as truncation removed + verified outcomes vs R2.3 (descriptive); local X rule as above; K4-K6 witness audit -> cohort proposal only (no collection without approval)
